statement.p: Evaluate the triple integral of f(x,y,z) = \cos(x^2 + y^2) over the solid cylinder with height 7 and with base of radius 1 centered on the z axis at z = -2.

static.solution: \int_W f\,dV = \int_{-2}^{5} \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^{1} (\cos(r^2)\, r\, dr\,d\theta\,dz. Integrating, \int_{-2}^{5} \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^{1} (\cos(r^2)\, r\, dr\,d\theta\,dz = \int_{-2}^{5} \int_0^{2\pi} \frac12\cdot\sin(r^2) \bigg|_{r=0}^{r=1}\,d\theta\,dz = \int_{-2}^{5} \int_0^{2\pi} \frac12(\sin(1))\,d\theta\,dz. \frac12(\sin(1))\int_{-2}^{5} 2\pi\,dz = 7\pi(\sin(1)).
